policy: Only downloadable models with verified redistribution licenses, pinned revisions and SHA-256 are installable. Candidate models are visible for research but not downloadable until Android runtime and license checks pass.

voices.name: Supertonic 3 · Arabic / English
voices.notes: Existing local engine. Arabic support is not a guarantee of perfect MSA pronunciation; compare voices and step counts on real devices.

voices.name: Nabra 7M Distill · Modern Standard Arabic
voices.license: Apache-2.0 model/library; bundled eSpeak NG component GPL-3.0-or-later
voices.notes: One experimental female MSA voice. Must pass listening and mobile performance tests before being marked recommended.

voices.name: SILMA TTS v1 · Arabic Fusha / English
voices.notes: 150M parameters. Current upstream usage is PyTorch/F5-TTS; Android ONNX/runtime compatibility and device speed are unverified. Do not expose as installable until port and checksums exist.

voices.name: Piper Arabic community voices
voices.license: Per-model license must be reviewed; some entries unspecified
voices.notes: Available voices include Jordanian/Saudi and Emirati pronunciations; not assumed to be neutral MSA.

voices.name: Meta MMS Arabic TTS
voices.notes: Non-commercial license; excluded from the public SAWT AI distribution.
